title: Constraint: Five Non-Adjacent Bits
constraints: `v` (16 bits) has exactly 5 ones, and no two of them are neighbours (792 such values exist).
Runs on Verilator with the z3 solver (`sudo pacman -S z3`).
hints: Verilator's constraint-to-SMT translation mis-sizes shift operators on vectors narrower than 32 bits (z3 then rejects the query and `randomize()` fails). Use part-selects and concatenation instead: `v >> 1` becomes `{1'b0, v[15:1]}`.

examples.check: no two set bits are adjacent
examples.title: sparse
